structured_output.rationale: All four lines (97140 ×2, 97530 ×2) denied CO-4/N822. These are always-therapy CPTs requiring a discipline modifier (GP for PT, GO for OT, GN for SLP). None of the 837P SV1 segments carry any modifier. Chart note confirms PT services → GP required on every line. Remedy is a new original claim; filing clock started 2026-06-23, well inside Medicare's 1-year limit.

root_cause.explanation: CPTs 97140 and 97530 billed without GP modifier on all four lines. CO-4/N822 on always-therapy codes = returned unprocessable for missing discipline modifier.

next_action.detail: Resubmit as new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8). Append GP to all four SV1 lines. Do not use frequency 7 — Medicare Part B rejects it.

evidence.fact: All four lines carry CAS*CO*4 + LQ*HE*N822 — CARC 4 (required modifier missing) and N822 (missing procedure modifier).
evidence.locator: SVC lines 1–4, CAS and LQ segments

evidence.fact: SV1 segments for all four lines list HC:97140 and HC:97530 with no modifier.
Services are PT (manual therapy, therapeutic activities) under a PT plan of care — GP modifier required on every line.

citations.rule: CO-4 + N822 on always-therapy CPTs with no GP/GO/GN = missing_therapy_modifier; remedy is new original claim CLM05-3=1 with modifier appended.
Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7; submit as CLM05-3=1.
